Hi Luis — great to meet you yesterday. We're excited to get Hexacore live. Short answer: same list you called out. To be explicit, procurement needs:

- Executed DPA (we can send our template or accept your edits)
- SOC 2 Type II report (hosted link OK)
- Current subprocessor list (CSV or Drive link)
- Completed vendor security questionnaire (we'll attach ours below)
- Billing details + W-9 (you already attached W-9, thanks)

For PO routing: finance@redwoodinference.com is the address to which Hexacore should send the PO once issued. PO number format is PO-YYYY-XXXXX (e.g., PO-2028-01234). Please add Redwood Inference legal name exactly as 'Redwood Inference, Inc.' on the PO.

I'll drop the DPA template and our questionnaire to this thread. Laura will confirm contractual intake and next steps for supplier setup. Aditya on this thread will own go-live coordination with your integration team.

Thanks — I'll watch for the DocuSign link for the DPA or your redlined file.

Luis — copying procurement ops here. Quick process notes so your finance team can proceed without delay:

1) Submit the PO to finance@redwoodinference.com with the subject line: "PO Submission — Hexacore Inc. — PO-<number>".
2) Include your Hexacore remit-to/ACH details in the PO body and attach the W-9 (you already did — we'll store).
3) For payment terms we have standard Net30 unless alternative terms are negotiated under SOW.
4) Attach the executed DPA (DocuSign is fine) OR send a redline of our DPA. If you send redlines, please add a 72-hour window for legal review.

When finance receives the PO + executed DPA + W-9, supplier onboarding in our vendor portal typically completes in 2 business days. If SOC 2 or subprocessor evidence is outstanding, we can provision a limited sandbox account for integration testing, but production access requires the compliance gate closed.

If you want, I can open the vendor record now so we have a placeholder — tell me the EIN and preferred remit method.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Luis — I'm on security & privacy for vendor intake. A few clarifications on artifacts to accelerate acceptance:

- SOC 2: A hosted link to the full SOC 2 Type II report is preferred. Our team will validate the auditor, scope and date. If you can provide a link to the PDF or a vendor portal login, that works.
- Subprocessors: we need a timestamped list with service function, vendor name, and country of processing (CSV preferred).
- Questionnaire: please return the completed Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx I attached to Rishi. If any answers are 'no', add an explanation in the comments column.
- DPA: if you're using DocuSign, set signers so Hexacore signs first and Redwood countersigns. Here's our DocuSign starter link: https://docusign.com/embedded/signer/abcd1234

Once we have those items, I'll run an intake check and confirm within one business day. If there are critical nonconformities we may request mitigations (MFA for vendor staff, data residency guardrails) — I'll call out specifics if they arise.

Thanks — look forward to the links.
Grace O'Connor
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
[Link: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/soc2/Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027.pdf]
